description: Measured LiteRT (TensorFlow Lite) delegate compatibility: op-level matrix per backend and runtime version, edge-lint .tflite pre-flight for GPU/NPU/WebGPU fallback, dated device cards. Unofficial.
rules: Before deploying a .tflite to the LiteRT GPU or NPU delegate, run edge-lint with the matrix snapshot for that backend and runtime version; an op with no measured entry reports 'unknown', never a guess.
Matrix snapshots are per (backend, litert_version); delegate support changes between runtime versions, so match the snapshot to the runtime you ship.
Rewrite hints in lint output come verbatim from measured matrix entries; edge-fix applies the recorded transforms as a dry run and never modifies the input file in place.
Model cards (cards/<model>/CARD.md, card.json) are the source of measured latency and delegation results; every number carries its device, runtime version and date.
